subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and should the currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a public config and accounting/display contract across model config, provider catalog metadata, session status, UI aggregation, and persisted USD-named fields; source inspection cannot safely choose those semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define currency contract first
options.body: Choose the currency scope and mixed-currency behavior before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave configured model costs as USD estimates and handle provider billing currencies only through provider usage/billing snapshots.

options.title: Add display-only symbol
options.body: Implement a narrow formatter override while explicitly accepting that stored totals and telemetry remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Define currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the currency scope and mixed-currency behavior before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-history connection to usage cost reporting and `/usage` cost summaries, which are the core contract surfaces here.
